runs.question: Why did product reads become slow while the database remained reachable?

observations.claim: The products service experienced query cancellation due to statement timeout after waiting for a relation lock for 2900 ms.
The database service logged that the products session pr5 was blocked by session migration-8 holding an AccessExclusiveLock on the products relation.
The database remained reachable as indicated by a successful SELECT 1 probe returning in 1 ms during the incident period.

missing_evidence: Detailed timing and duration of the migration-8 transaction holding the lock
Additional logs showing if other queries were similarly blocked or timed out

likely_cause.claim: Product reads became slow because the products service queries were blocked waiting for an AccessExclusiveLock held by a long-running migration transaction on the products table, causing query timeouts despite the database being reachable.

suggested_checks: Check the duration and timing of the migration-8 transaction holding the AccessExclusiveLock on the products table
Review other query logs for additional blocking or timeouts during the migration period
